orientation.where_this_fits: First exact-contract market-structure reproduction in Programme 002; establishes whether canonical Henry Hub data preserve the Samuelson maturity-volatility stylized fact before any predictive work.
orientation.programme_question: Which externally documented Henry Hub behaviours reproduce under source-faithful exact-contract data and semantics?

parent_question: Does Henry Hub listed-contract volatility decline with time to maturity under same-contract, liquidity-safe construction?
uncertainty_reduced: Whether the Samuelson maturity effect is reproducible in canonical Henry Hub contract history and whether its winter dependence is directionally coherent.
mechanism: Delivery-relevant information and physical scarcity shocks become more important as contract maturity approaches, increasing near-contract volatility.

hypotheses.h0: The predeclared ordered maturity-volatility contrast is non-positive or smaller than the scientific MEPI under informative power.
hypotheses.h1: Mean absolute same-contract daily log return decreases across the predeclared DTE buckets in the Samuelson direction by at least the scientific MEPI, with the winter-withdrawal interaction reported separately.

expected: Mean absolute same-contract log return decreases in the predeclared order as DTE increases.
The Samuelson contrast is present in winter-withdrawal months and is not stronger in the opposite direction outside winter.
disconfirming: The ordered DTE contrast is flat or opposite under informative power.
Any apparent maturity effect depends on cross-contract returns or on price-conditioned liquidity filtering.
The winter interaction is opposite the literature-reported seasonal pattern without a source-fidelity explanation.

forecast.prediction_timestamp_semantics: not predictive; descriptive session-close contract state
forecast.information_cutoff_semantics: exact acquired market snapshot; no post-outcome sample rule changes

model.training_rules: No model fitting or tuning. Fixed DTE buckets (0,30], (30,60], (60,90], (90,180], (180,365], (365,+inf); primary liquidity requires finite cleared volume > 0; primary volatility proxy is absolute same-contract daily log return.

evaluation.inference_procedure: contract-clustered ordered contrast with calendar-year block-bootstrap sensitivity

outcome_logic.success: Primary ordered contrast is in the Samuelson direction, reaches >=0.25 standardized MEPI, uncertainty excludes zero/disconfirming direction, and required semantic/robustness checks do not invalidate the claim.
outcome_logic.failure: Primary contrast is non-positive/reversed under informative power, depends on roll contamination, or required winter/source-fidelity checks contradict the claim.
outcome_logic.inconclusive: Direction is literature-consistent but uncertainty cannot distinguish the 0.25 MEPI/disconfirming region.
